sentences.en: On the memo was scrawled, "have her practice floating in the water."
sentences.zh: 备忘录上潦草地写着：‘让她练习在水里漂浮。’

sentences.en: The company sent out a memo with an apology for the mistake.
sentences.zh: 公司发出了一份致歉备忘录。

sentences.en: Lend me a memo pad or something.
sentences.zh: 借我一个便签本或者什么的吧。
